Heating, Cooling & Plumbing Services

Air Crew HVAC offers the highest quality of residential and commercial air conditioning, heating, and plumbing services across Morris, Essex, Hudson, Bergen, and Passaic County — and beyond. Our experienced technicians are the foundation of our commitment to providing top-notch service with a personal touch, ensuring total customer satisfaction. Air Crew HVAC is your one-stop shop for superior and reliable HVAC servicing.

Heating

HEATING REPAIR & INSTALL

Stay warm and comfortable during the cold months. From furnace repairs to new heater installations, our experienced technicians keep your heating system efficient and effective.

Heating Services

Beat the heat with professional cooling services. Specializing in AC installation, maintenance, and repair, keeping your home or office comfortable all summer long.

Cooling Services

Air Crew Heating and Cooling
92 Google reviews
Write a review
Liliana Seabra
Joe came out same day to fix an AC vent that wasn’t working in one of our rooms. He was quick & efficient and his prices are unbeatable!
William Gogerty
If you are not using Joe/ AirCrew for your HVAC needs you are using the wrong company. Joe is outstanding, thorough, explains in detail the issue and bring the greatest traits of honesty and integrity! Joe came in, went through our entire unit, resolved the issue with detailed explanations and serviced our unit completely! Excellent company and HIGHLY recommend Joe!
Linda
Joe is knowledgeable, professional and HONEST. He came on time, explained the problem thoroughly and gave a very fair price. I highly recommend his services!
Daenita Taylor
I recently had a clogged kitchen sink and needed someone quickly. I called up Joe, who was recommended by a family friend. He came over to the house immediately. He basically had to use the snake all the way down to the basement drain. He explained the whole process of unclogging the drain. He is very knowledgeable and affordable. Thank you, Joe.
Kelsey Fowler
Air Crew did an outstanding job replacing our HVAC system, installing a new AC condenser and gas furnace. From the get-go, they were efficient and accommodating, scheduling the installation quickly after our initial quote. The installation itself was completed in a day, and the team maintained a high level of professionalism throughout the process. They thoroughly tested the new system, left the area clean, and answered all of our questions. Their rates were very reasonable! I would highly recommend Air Crew for any HVAC needs. Thank you Joe and team!
Lee Jones
Great Service!! Air Crew quickly responded to my inquiry regarding a kitchen sink leak. Joe, the owner, came over and fixed the numerous issues with my sink. He offered advice on maintenance, was professional, courteous and a pleasure to deal with. He also fixed my long suffering outdoor spigot. I would not hesitate to use Air Crew for any plumbing issue. I also plan to use their HVAC services to maintain my air system this coming season. I highly recommend Air Crew Heating and Cooling.
Daisy Wong
Joe, the owner of Air Crew, repaired my hot water boiler. Joe is very polite, responsive and professional. He explained to me what repair was needed and completed the job in a timely manner. I'm very happy with his high quality of work. Joe also helped me understand more about the heating and cooling systems, and when maintenance vs. replacement is needed. I highly recommend Joe!
Willy
I called Joe on a Saturday morning after my boiler quit for good. He came over right away, surveyed the situation and indicated he could install a new boiler on Monday. He and his helper completed the job as promised and did excellent work. If you’re looking for an honest and professional plumber, I strongly recommend you contact Air Crew and Joe.
Jason Calabrese
If you are looking for an honest, reputable and skilled HVAC technician I absolutely recommend Joe at Air Crew HVAC in Fairfield, NJ. He came to my home on a Saturday afternoon to help diagnose an issue with my furnace. He made time out of his filled schedule to stop by and give me free advice. He is a rare person in this business because he is not just looking to make money, but he actually cares about helping people as well! He will make sure you are satisfied with his work and will charge a fair and reasonable price. Do not hesitate to contact Joe for all of your HVAC and plumbing needs!

WHAT WE DO

Your Go-To For Heating, Cooling & Plumbing.
Air Conditioner Installations & Repair

From routine repairs to new installs, our cooling experts keep your home comfortable through every North Jersey summer — with seasonal tune-ups to match.

Air Conditioner Replacement

Old unit struggling or gone completely? We size, install, and set up your new AC system — done right the first time.

Heating Repair & Maintenance

From furnace tune-ups to full system diagnostics, our technicians keep your heater running efficiently through the coldest North Jersey winters.

Plumbing & Drain Cleaning

Leaky faucets, clogged drains, sewer line backups — we handle everyday plumbing issues fast, before they turn into bigger problems.

Heating Replacement

When repairs no longer make sense, we help you upgrade to a new, energy-efficient heating system sized right for your home — installed fast and done right.

Heating Conversions

Switching from oil to gas or upgrading your fuel source? We handle the full conversion, maximizing efficiency and long-term savings.

AVAILABLE AROUND THE CLOCK

No Heat? No AC?
We're Here 24/7.

HVAC emergencies don't wait for business hours — and neither do we. Our team is on call 7 days a week, 24 hours a day across North Jersey.

ABOUT US

#1 HVAC SERVICES IN NORTH JERSEY

Air Crew Heating & Cooling

Air Crew HVAC is a family-owned and operated business dedicated to delivering top-of-the-line HVAC and plumbing services to all our valued customers across North Jersey. We're proud to help our clients keep warm in the winter, cool in the summer, and live comfortably all year long.

Our mission has always been to exceed expectations by providing prompt and reliable service accompanied by high standards of excellence. From installation and repair to maintenance contracts and inspections — we're here for all your heating, cooling, and plumbing needs.

WHAT WE STAND FOR

Why Choose Air Crew HVAC?

Our team has built a reputation for delivering reliable HVAC, plumbing, and drain cleaning services throughout North Jersey.

Honest Recommendations

We tell you what actually needs to be done — not what's most profitable for us. Repair or replace, we give you the straight answer.

Quality Workmanship

Every job is done right the first time. We stand behind our work with licensed, experienced technicians who take pride in the details.

Dependable Service

Homeowners and businesses across North Jersey trust us because we show up when we say we will, and we're there 24/7 when it matters most.

"
